phrases: a great deal of
大量的（后接不可数名词）
There was a great deal of excitement just before the race began.
比赛开始前有大量的兴奋情绪。
take part in
参加；参与（活动或比赛）
It was the oldest car taking part in the race.
这是参加比赛的最老的汽车。
break down
（机器或车辆）出故障；抛锚
Many of the cars broke down on the course.
许多汽车在赛道上抛锚了。
have trouble doing something
做某事有困难
The driver had a lot of trouble trying to stop it.
司机费了很大劲才把它停下来。
at the end of
在...结束时；在...末尾
It sped downhill at the end of the race.
它在比赛结束时加速下坡。
give someone pleasure
给某人带来快乐
The race gave everyone a great deal of pleasure.
比赛给每个人都带来了很大的乐趣。
be different from
与...不同
It was very different from modern car races.
它与现代汽车比赛非常不同。
once a year
每年一次
Once a year, a race is held for old cars.
每年举行一次老式汽车比赛。
spend time doing something
花时间做某事
Some drivers spent more time under their cars than in them!
一些司机花在车底下的时间比在车里的时间还多！
no less exciting
同样精彩（双重否定表示肯定）
It was very different but no less exciting.
它非常不同，但同样精彩。

grammar.d: 描述过去发生的动作或存在的状态 叙述过去的事件，故事背景等
ex: A lot of cars entered for this race last year.
去年很多汽车报名参加了比赛。
The race began after a great many loud explosions.
在一阵巨大的爆炸声后，比赛开始了。
The winning car reached a speed of forty miles an hour.
获胜的车辆达到了每小时四十英里的速度。

grammar.d: 表示三者或以上中最... 用于比较多个事物时，指出最...的一个
ex: One of the most handsome cars was a Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost.
最漂亮的汽车之一是一辆劳斯莱斯银魅。
It was the oldest car taking part.
这是参加比赛的最老的汽车。

grammar.d: 描述过去正在进行的动作 描述过去某个时刻正在发生的动作
ex: There was a great deal of excitement just before it began.
比赛开始前有大量的兴奋情绪。

o: Once a year, a race is held for old cars.
每年举行一次老式汽车比赛。
im: Once a year, we have a reunion with old friends.
每年我们都会和老朋友聚会一次。
Once a year, the town holds a flower festival.
这个城镇每年举办一次花展。

patterns.p: There was/were + 名词 + 形容词/介词短语
o: There was a great deal of excitement just before it began.
比赛开始前有大量的兴奋情绪。
im: There was a great deal of traffic on the road.
There were many people waiting at the station.

patterns.p: 主语 + had (a lot of) trouble doing something
o: The driver had a lot of trouble trying to stop it.
司机费了很大劲才把它停下来。
im: I had a lot of trouble finding your house.
我费了很大劲才找到你家。
She had trouble understanding the lecture.

patterns.p: It was + the + 最高级 + 名词 + doing/定语从句
o: Built in 1885, it was the oldest car taking part.
它制造于1885年，是参加比赛的最老的汽车。
im: Written in 1990, it was the most popular book that year.
写于1990年，它是那一年最受欢迎的书。
Located in the center, it was the most convenient hotel to stay.
位于中心地带，它是最便利的住宿酒店。
